_comment: Loombre :: packages/shared/test/fixtures/redact-path-vectors.json — F4 (M-7 fix wave). ONE golden-vector fixture consumed by BOTH the packages/shared canonical redactPathsInText(text, () => true) suite AND packages/jobs's redactAllPaths unit suite (packages/jobs takes no @loombre/shared dependency, so its test reads this file by relative path rather than importing it). Both functions MUST produce `expected` for `input` — a future divergence in the UNC / stack-frame / file:// / glued-prefix / space-containing rules between the two package-local copies surfaces here as a failure in one package or the other, not silently. Every `expected` is the UNCONDITIONAL redact-all outcome (shouldRedact => true), so it is the exact byte string BOTH functions produce.

vectors.name: quoted POSIX path with a parenthesised directory segment
vectors.input: ENOENT: no such file or directory, open '/data/library/Movies/Film (2020)/movie.mkv'
vectors.expected: ENOENT: no such file or directory, open '<redacted>/movie.mkv'

vectors.name: bare (unquoted) POSIX path, no internal space

vectors.expected: scan failed: staging path <redacted>/incoming-xyz not found
